title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（平間淳司研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Hirama Junji)
teachers:
HIRAMA Junji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Topic: Research based on the specialized knowledge and skills acquired during previous classes.  Project themes contribute topics in the following fields; electrical/electronic engineering, agriculture, biology. The results obtained in this research have the potential to greatly contribute to society.
Objective: To improve upon specialized technical knowledge and develop exceptional engineers.
advice:
This course summarizes the project design process while integrating and reviewing all of the subjects previously studied, from the basics to the specialized and advanced.Students enrolled in one of the subjects listed below will be divided into groups and conduct research activities throughout the school year. A research notebook will be submitted daily, and meetings once a week will be conducted.
(1)Development of equipment to physically control insect pests using light（This theme has been inactive since FY2024.）
(a)This topic focuses on developing a pesticide-free and environmentally friendly insect pest control
light source device by utilizing specially fluctuating ultra-bright light-emitting diodes (LED).
(b) Measure the light stimulus response (electrophysiology) from the retinal potential of insects (moths and stink bugs). Furthermore, verify the phototaxis of the insects by behavioral observation.
(2)Plant bioelectrophysiology
(a) Investigate the bioelectrophysiological phenomena of plants by measuring the bioelectric potential response to ambient environmental stimulation conditions.
(b) Optimized plant factory environmental control
(3) Biomagnetic field measurement application: Using a prototype MRI device, measure various biological information in a non-invasive and none-destructive manner.
(4) Development of ultra-low magnetic field measuring equipment: development of the Flux Gate Magnetometer
requiredKnowledge: PDIII combines the various knowledge obtained during the undergraduate period. It is a laboratory class that conducts research activities based on existing research themes. Therefore, the goal is to peruse self-development by working with teachers, senior students and fellow students. In particular, it is important to learn how to apply and use electronic circuits, magnetics, measurement and controls and biology.

activityGoals.body: To understand the purpose of the research, understand the content, and how to plan research projects
To communicate well with faculty members and other students in order to advance the research.
To fulfill your research goals by solving problems and issues that occur.
To compile the research results into project reports (research papers).
To explain the research contents and effectively present the research results.

achievementLevels.ideal:
To fulfill the high level learning objectives for the project theme and engineering design process.
To reach a level where the research results can be fully disclosed in an academic forum, and leave major contributions for future research.
achievementLevels.standard: To fully understand the purpose of the project theme and to meet the goals that should be learned during the engineering design process. To achieve the final research results.
